title: Madhya-khanda, part 2 (portion 25)
html:
The gods come to the Lord and receive prema; mercy to Shuklambara and Gadadhara; the dance in Srivasa's house — Vrindavana in Navadvipa; the Lord disperses the clouds over the kirtana; the section "Mercy to Mukunda": a song of Gaura's dance

Raga dhanashi

নবদ্বীপে নিতুই পূর্ণিমাচাঁদ গোরা ।
প্রকাশয়ে নিজ-প্রেম-অমিয়ার ধারা ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

nabadbīpe nitui pūrṇimācāṁda gorā |
prakāśaẏe nija-prema-amiẏāra dhārā || 139 ||

navadvipe — in Navadvipa; nitui — ever; purnima-chanda gora — Gora, the full moon; prakashaye — reveals, pours out; nija-prema-amiyara dhara — streams of the nectar of His own prema

139In Navadvipa Gora is the ever-full moon:
He pours out streams of the nectar of His own prema.

পিবই চরণামৃত ভকত-চকোরা ।
অবাধ করুণা প্রেমা প্রকাশয়ে গোরা ॥ ১৪০ ॥

pibai caraṇāmṛta bhakata-cakorā |
abādha karuṇā premā prakāśaẏe gorā || 140 ||

pibai — drink; charanamrita — the nectar of the feet; bhakata-chakora — the devotee-chakoras; abadha karuna — boundless compassion; prema — prema; prakashaye gora — Gora reveals

140The devotee-chakoras drink the nectar of His feet;
boundless compassion — prema — Gora reveals.

আর এক-দিনে কথা শুন অপরূপ ।
নিজঘরে বসি' তেজঃ কোটি-কাম-রূপ ॥ ১৪১ ॥

āra eka-dine kathā śuna aparūpa |
nijaghare basi' tejaḥ koṭi-kāma-rūpa || 141 ||

ara eka-dine — on another day; katha shuna aparupa — hear a wonderful story; nija-ghare basi — sitting in His own house; tejah — radiance; koti-kama-rupa — the beauty of millions of Kamadevas

141Hear a wonderful story of yet another day.
He sits in His own house, radiant as millions of Kamadevas:

সিংহগ্রীব কম্বুকণ্ঠ কমললোচন ।
কহয়ে প্রকট ঘন গম্ভীর বচন ॥ ১৪২ ॥

siṃhagrība kambukaṇṭha kamalalocana |
kahaẏe prakaṭa ghana gambhīra bacana || 142 ||

simha-griva — lion-necked; kambu-kantha — with a conch-like throat; kamala-lochana — lotus-eyed; kahaye prakata — speaks aloud; ghana gambhira bachana — words deep as thunder

142a neck like a lion's, a throat like a conch, lotus eyes;
and aloud He speaks words deep as thunder:

এ ঘরে কি দেখি চারি-পাঁচ-ছয়-মুখ ।
দেখিতে বাঢ়য়ে মোর অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

e ghare ki dekhi cāri-pāṁca-chaẏa-mukha |
dekhite bāṛhaẏe mora antara-kautuka || 143 ||

e ghare — in this house; ki dekhi — what do I see; chari-pancha-chhaya-mukha — four-, five-, six-faced ones; dekhite — on seeing; badhaye — grows; mora antara-kautuka — the wonder of My heart

143"What do I see in this house — four-, five-, six-faced ones?
At the sight of them wonder grows in My heart."

শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিত আছিল প্রভু-কাছে ।
শুনিঞা উত্তর দিল যে বিধান আছে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

śrīnibāsa-paṇḍita āchila prabhu-kāche |
śuniñā uttara dila ye bidhāna āche || 144 ||

shrinibasa-pandita — Srinivasa Pandita; achhila prabhu-kachhe — was near the Lord; shunina — having heard; uttara dila — gave an answer; ye vidhana achhe — as the matter stands

144Srinivasa Pandita was beside the Lord;
hearing this, he answered as the matter stood:

তোমা দেখিবারে সব দেব-আগমন ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি চারি পাঁচ ছয় যে বদন ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

tomā dekhibāre saba deba-āgamana |
brahmā-ādi cāri pāṁca chaẏa ye badana || 145 ||

toma dekhibare — to see You; saba deva-agamana — the coming of all the gods; brahma-adi — Brahma and others; chari pancha chhaya ye badana — those with four, five, six faces

145"All the gods have come to see You —
Brahma and the others, the four-, five- and six-faced.

প্রেমার সমুদ্র তুমি দেহ প্রেমধন ।
তোরে প্রেমধন মাগে সব দেবগণ ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

premāra samudra tumi deha premadhana |
tore premadhana māge saba debagaṇa || 146 ||

premara samudra tumi — You are the ocean of prema; deha premadhana — give the treasure of prema; tore — of You; premadhana mage — beg the treasure of prema; saba deva-gana — all the gods

146You are an ocean of prema: give [them] the treasure of prema!
All the gods are begging You for the treasure of prema"1.

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বসি' দিব্যাসনে ।
এক ভক্ত-অঙ্গে অঙ্গ পদ আর জনে ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu basi' dibyāsane |
eka bhakta-aṅge aṅga pada āra jane || 147 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; basi divyasane — sitting on a divine seat; eka bhakta-ange anga — His body on one devotee's body; pada ara jane — His feet on another

147Then Mahaprabhu sat on a divine seat,
leaning His body on one devotee and [placing] His feet on another2.

শ্রীনিবাস-আদি করি যত ভক্তজন ।
চরণে পড়িয়া তারা করয়ে রোদন ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

śrīnibāsa-ādi kari yata bhaktajana |
caraṇe paṛiẏā tārā karaẏe rodana || 148 ||

shrinibasa-adi kari — Srinivasa and the rest; yata bhakta-jana — all the devotees; charane padiya — falling at the feet; tara karaye rodana — they weep

148Srinivasa and all the other devotees
fell at His feet and weep:

বর মাগোঁ তোর পদাম্বুজ-মধু-প্রেমা ।
দেহ ত আমারে প্রভু করুণার সীমা ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

bara māgoṁ tora padāmbuja-madhu-premā |
deha ta āmāre prabhu karuṇāra sīmā || 149 ||

bara mago — I beg a boon; tora padambuja-madhu-prema — the honey-prema of Your lotus feet; deha ta amare — do give me; prabhu — Lord; karunara sima — limit of compassion

149"I beg a boon — the honey-prema of Your lotus feet:
give it to me, Lord, O utmost limit of compassion!"

তবে বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু বোলে মেঘনাদে ।
লেহ ত সভারে দিল প্রেম-পরসাদে ॥ ১৫০ ॥

tabe biśbambhara prabhu bole meghanāde |
leha ta sabhāre dila prema-parasāde || 150 ||

tabe vishvambhara prabhu — then Lord Vishvambhara; bole megha-nade — speaks with the sound of thunder; leha ta — take it; sabhare dila — gave to all; prema-parasade — the grace of prema

150Then Lord Vishvambhara speaks in a voice like thunder:
"Take it!" — and gave to all the grace of prema.

তৎকাল হইল প্রেম সব দেবতার ।
ভাবময় শরীর হইল চমৎকার ॥ ১৫১ ॥

tatkāla haila prema saba debatāra |
bhābamaẏa śarīra haila camatkāra || 151 ||

tat-kala — at once; haila prema — prema arose; saba devatara — in all the gods; bhavamaya sharira — bodies full of bhava; haila chamatkara — became wondrous

151At once prema awoke in all the gods:
their bodies, filled with bhava, became wondrous.

হা রাধাগোবিন্দ বলি' নাচে দেবগণ ।
দেখিয়া বৈষ্ণব সব হরষিত মন ॥ ১৫২ ॥

hā rādhāgobinda bali' nāce debagaṇa |
dekhiẏā baiṣṇaba saba haraṣita mana || 152 ||

ha radha-govinda bali — crying "O Radha-Govinda!"; nache deva-gana — the gods dance; dekhiya — seeing; vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas; harashita mana — are glad at heart

152Crying "O Radha-Govinda!", the gods dance;
seeing it, all the Vaishnavas rejoice at heart.

দেবগণ নাচে দেবীগণ করি' সঙ্গে ।
অশ্রু পুলক স্বেদ প্রেমার তরঙ্গে ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

debagaṇa nāce debīgaṇa kari' saṅge |
aśru pulaka sbeda premāra taraṅge || 153 ||

deva-gana nache — the gods dance; devi-gana kari sange — with the goddesses; ashru pulaka sveda — tears, thrill, sweat; premara tarange — in the waves of prema

153The gods dance, and the goddesses with them:
tears, thrill, sweat — in waves of prema.

ক্ষণে ভূমে গড়ি যায় চরণে পড়িয়া ।
ক্ষণে উভরায়ে নাচে হরিবোল বলিয়া ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

kṣaṇe bhūme gaṛi yāẏa caraṇe paṛiẏā |
kṣaṇe ubharāẏe nāce haribola baliẏā || 154 ||

kshane — now; bhume gadi yaya — they roll on the ground; charane padiya — falling at the feet; kshane — now; ubharaye nache — they dance crying aloud; haribola baliya — saying "Haribol!"

154Now they roll on the ground, falling at His feet,
now they dance, loudly crying "Haribol!",

ক্ষণে স্তব করে গৌরগোবিন্দ বলিয়া ।
ক্ষণে দণ্ডবৎ করে চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

kṣaṇe staba kare gauragobinda baliẏā |
kṣaṇe daṇḍabat kare caraṇe paṛiẏā || 155 ||

kshane stava kare — now they offer praise; gaura-govinda baliya — calling "Gaura-Govinda!"; kshane dandavat kare — now they prostrate; charane padiya — falling at the feet

155now they offer praise, calling "Gaura-Govinda!",
now they prostrate themselves, falling at His feet.

ক্ষণে পদ মস্তকে ধরিয়া দেবগণ ।
বর মাগে তোর পদে রহু মোর মন ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

kṣaṇe pada mastake dhariẏā debagaṇa |
bara māge tora pade rahu mora mana || 156 ||

kshane pada mastake dhariya — now holding [His] feet on their heads; deva-gana — the gods; bara mage — beg a boon; tora pade — at Your feet; rahu mora mana — may my mind remain

156Now, placing His feet on their heads, the gods
beg a boon: "May my mind abide at Your feet!"

তথাস্তু বলিয়া প্রভু বোলে বার বার ।
প্রেমধন পরিপূর্ণ হউ তো-সভার ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

tathāstu baliẏā prabhu bole bāra bāra |
premadhana paripūrṇa hau to-sabhāra || 157 ||

tathastu baliya — saying "so be it"; prabhu bole bara bara — the Lord says again and again; premadhana paripurna — full of the treasure of prema; hau to-sabhara — may you all be

157"So be it," the Lord replies, and says again and again:
"May you all be filled with the treasure of prema!"

দেবগণ প্রেম পাই' গেলা নিজস্থান ।
দেখিয়া সকল ভক্ত আনন্দিতমন ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

debagaṇa prema pāi' gelā nijasthāna |
dekhiẏā sakala bhakta ānanditamana || 158 ||

deva-gana prema pai — the gods, having obtained prema; gela nija-sthana — went to their own abodes; dekhiya — seeing; sakala bhakta — all the devotees; anandita-mana — were joyful at heart

158Having received prema, the gods went to their own abodes;
seeing it, all the devotees rejoiced at heart.

এতেক করুণা কৈল ভক্তবৎসল ।
করুণা-প্রকাশ দেখি' বোলে শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

eteka karuṇā kaila bhaktabatsala |
karuṇā-prakāśa dekhi' bole śuklāmbara || 159 ||

eteka karuna kaila — such mercy showed; bhakta-vatsala — the Lover of His devotees; karuna-prakasha dekhi — seeing the display of mercy; bole shuklambara — Shuklambara speaks

159Such mercy did the Lover of His devotees show.
Seeing this display of mercy, Shuklambara speaks.

শুক্লাম্বর ব্রহ্মচারী বড়ই পবিত্র ।
তীর্থপূত-কলেবর মধুরচরিত্র ॥ ১৬০ ॥

śuklāmbara brahmacārī baṛai pabitra |
tīrthapūta-kalebara madhuracaritra || 160 ||

shuklambara brahmachari — Shuklambara Brahmachari; badai pavitra — very pure; tirtha-puta-kalebara — his body hallowed by holy places; madhura-charitra — of sweet nature

160Shuklambara Brahmachari is most pure:
his body is hallowed by holy places, his nature is gentle.

প্রভু-আগে কহে কথা নাহি করে ভয় ।
প্রেম-লোভে কহে কথা যত মনে লয় ॥ ১৬১ ॥

prabhu-āge kahe kathā nāhi kare bhaẏa |
prema-lobhe kahe kathā yata mane laẏa || 161 ||

prabhu-age — before the Lord; kahe katha — he speaks; nahi kare bhaya — without fear; prema-lobhe — in longing for prema; kahe katha — he says; yata mane laya — all that comes to mind

161Before the Lord he speaks without fear;
longing for prema, he says all that is in his heart:

শুন শুন অহে প্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
এতদিনে হৈল মোর প্রসন্ন-নয়ান ॥ ১৬২ ॥

śuna śuna ahe prabhu gaura bhagabān |
etadine haila mora prasanna-naẏāna || 162 ||

shuna shuna — hear, hear; ahe prabhu — O Lord; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; eta-dine — at last (after so many days); haila mora prasanna-nayana — my eyes have become glad

162"Hear, hear, O Lord, Gaura Bhagavan:
at last today my eyes have found their joy.

নানা-তীর্থ-পর্যটন করিয়াছি আমি ।
অনেক যন্ত্রণা দুঃখ কিছুই না জানি ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

nānā-tīrtha-paryaṭana kariẏāchi āmi |
aneka yantraṇā duḥkha kichui nā jāni || 163 ||

nana-tirtha-paryatana — travel to many holy places; kariyachhi ami — I have made; aneka jantrana duhkha — much torment and hardship; kichhui na jani — I know nothing

163I have travelled to many holy places,
[suffered] many torments and hardships — and have understood nothing.

মধুপুরী দ্বারাবতী কৈলুঁ পর্যটন ।
দুঃখিত হঞাছি আমি দেহ প্রেমধন ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

madhupurī dbārābatī kailuṁ paryaṭana |
duḥkhita hañāchi āmi deha premadhana || 164 ||

madhupuri — Madhupuri (Mathura); dvaravati — Dvaravati (Dvaraka); kailun paryatana — I have travelled to; duhkhita hanachhi ami — I am unhappy; deha premadhana — give the treasure of prema

164I have travelled to Madhupuri and Dvaravati,
and still I am unhappy: give me the treasure of prema!"

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু কহিল উত্তর ।
মোর এক বোল তুমি শুন শুক্লাম্বর ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu kahila uttara |
mora eka bola tumi śuna śuklāmbara || 165 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; prabhu kahila uttara — the Lord answered; mora eka bola — one word of Mine; tumi shuna — you hear; shuklambara — Shuklambara

165Hearing these words, the Lord answered:
"Hear one word of Mine, Shuklambara:

সে বনে কতেক আছে শৃগাল-কুক্কুর ।
আমার কি হৈল তাথে কহিল ঠাকুর ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

se bane kateka āche śṛgāla-kukkura |
āmāra ki haila tāthe kahila ṭhākura || 166 ||

se bane — in those forests; kateka achhe — ever so many live; shrigala-kukkura — jackals and dogs; amara ki haila tathe — what is that to Me; kahila thakura — said the Thakura

166in those forests live ever so many jackals and dogs —
what is that to Me?" said the Thakura3.

হৃদয়ে যাবত কৃষ্ণ উদয় না করে ।
তাবত তীর্থের অনুগ্রহ নাহি তারে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

hṛdaẏe yābata kṛṣṇa udaẏa nā kare |
tābata tīrthera anugraha nāhi tāre || 167 ||

hridaye — in the heart; yabata krishna udaya na kare — as long as Krishna does not rise; tabata — so long; tirthera anugraha — the grace of the holy places; nahi tare — he has not

167"As long as Krishna does not rise in the heart,
so long one has no grace from the holy places.

কৃষ্ণপ্রেম বিনু ধর্ম কেহো কিছু নহে ।
পড়িয়া দেখহ ইহা শাস্ত্রে সব কহে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

kṛṣṇaprema binu dharma keho kichu nahe |
paṛiẏā dekhaha ihā śāstre saba kahe || 168 ||

krishna-prema vinu — without love for Krishna; dharma keho kichhu nahe — no dharma is anything; padiya dekhaha — read and see; iha shastre saba kahe — the shastras all say this

168Without love for Krishna any dharma is nothing;
read and see: the shastras all say this."

Thus [it is said]:

মীনঃ স্নানপরঃ ফণী পবনভুঙ্ মেষোঽপি পর্ণাশনঃ
শশ্বদ্ভ্রাম্যতি চক্রিগৌরপি বকো ধ্যানে সদা তিষ্ঠতি ।
গর্তে তিষ্ঠতি মূষিকোঽপি গহনে সিংহঃ সদা বর্ততে
কিং তেষাং ফলমস্তি হন্ত তপসা সদ্ভাবসিদ্ধিং বিনা ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

mīnaḥ snānaparaḥ phaṇī pabanabhuṅ meṣo'pi parṇāśanaḥ
śaśbadbhrāmyati cakrigaurapi bako dhyāne sadā tiṣṭhati |
garte tiṣṭhati mūṣiko'pi gahane siṃhaḥ sadā bartate
kiṃ teṣāṃ phalamasti hanta tapasā sadbhābasiddhiṃ binā || 169 ||

minah snana-parah — the fish is intent on bathing; phani pavana-bhuk — the snake lives on air; meshah api parnashanah — the ram too eats leaves; shashvat bhramyati — ever goes round; chakri-gauh api — the oil-presser's ox too; bakah dhyane sada tishthati — the heron always stands in meditation; garte tishthati mushikah api — the mouse too lives in a hole; gahane simhah sada vartate — the lion always dwells in the thicket; kim tesham phalam asti — what fruit do they have; hanta — alas; tapasa — from austerity; sad-bhava-siddhim vina — without perfection in true feeling

169"The fish is always bathing, the snake lives on air, the ram eats leaves, the oil-presser's ox is ever going round, the heron always stands in meditation, the mouse lives in a hole, the lion always dwells in the thicket — but alas! what fruit do they have from austerity without perfection in true feeling?"4

Thus in the Narada-pancharatra (1.2.6):

আরাধিতো যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিং
নারাধিতো যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিম্ ।
অন্তর্বহির্যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিং
নান্তর্বহির্যদি হরিস্তপসা ততঃ কিম্ ॥ ১৭০ ॥

ārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ
nārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kim |
antarbahiryadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ
nāntarbahiryadi haristapasā tataḥ kim || 170 ||

aradhitah yadi harih — if Hari is worshipped; tapasa tatah kim — what then of austerity; na aradhitah yadi harih — if Hari is not worshipped; tapasa tatah kim — what then of austerity; antah bahih yadi harih — if Hari is within and without; na antah bahih yadi harih — if Hari is not within and without

170"If Hari is worshipped, what need of austerity? If Hari is not worshipped, what use is austerity? If Hari is within and without, what need of austerity? If Hari is not within and without, what use is austerity?"

এ বোল শুনিঞা বিপ্র ভূমেতে পড়িল ।
কাতর হইয়া কান্দে আরতি বাঢ়িল ॥ ১৭১ ॥

e bola śuniñā bipra bhūmete paṛila |
kātara haiẏā kānde ārati bāṛhila || 171 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; vipra bhumete padila — the brahmana fell to the ground; katara haiya kande — distraught, he weeps; arati badhila — his longing grew

171Hearing these words, the brahmana fell to the ground;
distraught, he weeps, and his longing grows.

অনুগত-আর্তি প্রভু সহিবারে নারে ।
করুণ অরুণ ভেল গৌর-কলেবরে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

anugata-ārti prabhu sahibāre nāre |
karuṇa aruṇa bhela gaura-kalebare || 172 ||

anugata-arti — the distress of one devoted; prabhu sahibare nare — the Lord cannot bear; karuna aruna bhela — flushed red with compassion; gaura-kalebare — Gaura's body

172The Lord cannot bear the distress of one devoted to Him:
Gaura's body flushed red with compassion.

প্রেম দিল প্রেম দিল ডাকে আর্তনাদে ।
শুক্লাম্বর বিপ্র পাইল প্রেম-পরসাদে ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

prema dila prema dila ḍāke ārtanāde |
śuklāmbara bipra pāila prema-parasāde || 173 ||

prema dila prema dila — I have given prema, given prema; dake arta-nade — He cries with a loud voice; shuklambara vipra — the brahmana Shuklambara; paila prema-parasade — obtained the grace of prema

173"I have given prema, given prema!" He cries aloud,
and the brahmana Shuklambara obtained the grace of prema.

তৎকালে পাইল প্রেম কম্পকলেবর ।
পুলকিত ভেল অঙ্গ নয়নেতে জল ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

tatkāle pāila prema kampakalebara |
pulakita bhela aṅga naẏanete jala || 174 ||

tat-kale — at once; paila prema — he obtained prema; kampa-kalebara — his body trembles; pulakita bhela anga — his limbs thrilled; nayanete jala — tears in his eyes

174At once he obtained prema: his body trembles,
his whole body thrills, there are tears in his eyes.

হরষিত হৈয়া তবে কৃষ্ণনাম লয় ।
সকল রজনী ভেল কৃষ্ণরসময় ॥ ১৭৪+১ ॥

haraṣita haiẏā tabe kṛṣṇanāma laẏa |
sakala rajanī bhela kṛṣṇarasamaẏa || 174+1 ||

harashita haiya — rejoicing; tabe — then; krishna-nama laya — repeats the name of Krishna; sakala rajani — the whole night; bhela — became; krishna-rasa-maya — full of the rasa of Krishna

174+1Rejoicing, he repeats the name of Krishna;
the whole night passed in the rasa of Krishna5.

হরিষে করয়ে গুণ-নাম-সংকীর্তন ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক অতি হৃষ্টমন ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

hariṣe karaẏe guṇa-nāma-saṃkīrtana |
dekhiẏā sakala loka ati hṛṣṭamana || 175 ||

harishe — rejoicing; karaye guna-nama-sankirtana — performs sankirtana of qualities and names; dekhiya — seeing; sakala loka — all the people; ati hrishta-mana — were very glad

175Rejoicing, he performs sankirtana of [the Lord's] qualities and names;
seeing it, all the people were very glad.

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর সর্বগুণধাম ।
প্রভু-কাছে থাকে নিরন্তর লয় নাম ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

paṇḍita śrīgadādhara sarbaguṇadhāma |
prabhu-kāche thāke nirantara laẏa nāma || 176 ||

pandita shri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; sarva-guna-dhama — the abode of all virtues; prabhu-kachhe thake — stays with the Lord; nirantara laya nama — constantly repeats the Name

176Pandita Sri Gadadhara — the abode of all virtues —
stays constantly with the Lord and repeats the Name.

রজনী শুতিয়া ছিলা প্রভুর সংহতি ।
পরিতোষে বৈল প্রভু দেখিয়া আরতি ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

rajanī śutiẏā chilā prabhura saṃhati |
paritoṣe baila prabhu dekhiẏā ārati || 177 ||

rajani — at night; shutiya chhila — he lay sleeping; prabhura samhati — with the Lord; paritoshe — pleased; baila prabhu — the Lord said; dekhiya arati — seeing his longing

177One night he slept beside the Lord;
seeing his longing, the Lord, pleased, said:

পাইবে দুর্লভ প্রেম রজনী-প্রভাতে ।
মনোরথ সিদ্ধি হৈব বৈষ্ণব-প্রসাদে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

pāibe durlabha prema rajanī-prabhāte |
manoratha siddhi haiba baiṣṇaba-prasāde || 178 ||

paibe — you will obtain; durlabha prema — rare prema; rajani-prabhate — at the dawn of the night; manaratha siddhi haiba — your desire will be fulfilled; vaishnava-prasade — by the grace of the Vaishnavas

178"You will obtain rare prema at the dawn of this night:
by the grace of the Vaishnavas your desire will be fulfilled"6.

ইহা বলি' অঙ্গমালা দিলা তার গলে ।
প্রভাতে আইলা সভে প্রভু দেখিবারে ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

ihā bali' aṅgamālā dilā tāra gale |
prabhāte āilā sabhe prabhu dekhibāre || 179 ||

iha bali — saying this; anga-mala — the garland from [His] body; dila tara gale — He put on his neck; prabhate — in the morning; aila sabhe — all came; prabhu dekhibare — to see the Lord

179Saying this, He put the garland from His own body round his neck.
In the morning all came to see the Lord.

সভারে কহিল প্রভু রজনী-চরিত ।
কথাছলে প্রেম পাইল গদাধর-পণ্ডিত ॥ ১৮০ ॥

sabhāre kahila prabhu rajanī-carita |
kathāchale prema pāila gadādhara-paṇḍita || 180 ||

sabhare kahila prabhu — the Lord told everyone; rajani-charita — the events of the night; katha-chhale — in the course of the talk; prema paila — obtained prema; gadadhara-pandita — Gadadhara Pandita

180The Lord told everyone what had happened in the night —
and in the course of that talk Gadadhara Pandita obtained prema.

অতি হৃষ্টমনে স্নান করি' গঙ্গাজলে ।
প্রেমায় অবশ তনু টলমল করে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

ati hṛṣṭamane snāna kari' gaṅgājale |
premāẏa abaśa tanu ṭalamala kare || 181 ||

ati hrishta-mane — with great joy at heart; snana kari gangajale — bathing in the waters of the Ganga; premaya avasha tanu — his body helpless with prema; talamala kare — sways

181With great joy at heart he bathed in the waters of the Ganga;
his body, helpless with prema, sways.

জগন্নাথদেব-পূজা করিল বিধানে ।
পুনঃ পূজা করে নিজ-প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে ॥ ১৮২ ॥

jagannāthadeba-pūjā karila bidhāne |
punaḥ pūjā kare nija-prabhu-bidyamāne || 182 ||

jagannatha-deva-puja — the worship of Jagannatha-deva; karila vidhane — he performed according to the rules; punah puja kare — again he worships; nija-prabhu-vidyamane — in the presence of his own Lord

182He performed the worship of Jagannatha-deva according to the rules,
and worships again — before his own Lord:

সুগন্ধি চন্দন অঙ্গে করিল লেপন ।
দিব্যমালা গলে দিয়া করয়ে স্তবন ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

sugandhi candana aṅge karila lepana |
dibyamālā gale diẏā karaẏe stabana || 183 ||

sugandhi chandana — fragrant sandal paste; ange karila lepana — he smeared on the body; divya-mala gale diya — putting a divine garland on the neck; karaye stavana — offers praise

183he anointed His body with fragrant sandal paste,
put a divine garland round His neck and offers praise.

এইমত প্রতিদিন করে পরিচর্যা ।
শয়নমন্দিরে করে শয়নের শয্যা ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

eimata pratidina kare paricaryā |
śaẏanamandire kare śaẏanera śayyā || 184 ||

eimata — thus; pratidina kare paricharya — every day he serves; shayana-mandire — in the bedchamber; kare shayanera shayya — he prepares the bed for sleep

184So every day he serves [the Lord]:
in the bedchamber he prepares His bed

চরণ-নিকটে নিতি করয়ে শয়ন ।
নিরন্তর শ্রদ্ধাভক্তি-পর তার মন ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

caraṇa-nikaṭe niti karaẏe śaẏana |
nirantara śraddhābhakti-para tāra mana || 185 ||

charana-nikate — near the feet; niti karaye shayana — daily he sleeps; nirantara — always; shraddha-bhakti-para — full of faith and devotion; tara mana — his heart

185and every night sleeps at His feet;
his heart is always full of faith and devotion7.

প্রভুর সম্মুখে কহে অমৃতবচন ।
শুনি' বিশ্বম্ভর প্রভু আনন্দিতমন ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

prabhura sammukhe kahe amṛtabacana |
śuni' biśbambhara prabhu ānanditamana || 186 ||

prabhura sammukhe — before the Lord; kahe amrita-bachana — he speaks nectarean words; shuni — hearing; vishvambhara prabhu — Lord Vishvambhara; anandita-mana — is joyful at heart

186Before the Lord he speaks nectarean words;
hearing them, Lord Vishvambhara rejoices at heart.

তাহার অমৃত-বাণী সিঞ্চিল অন্তর ।
নাচিবারে যায় প্রভু ধরি' তার কর ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

tāhāra amṛta-bāṇī siñcila antara |
nācibāre yāẏa prabhu dhari' tāra kara || 187 ||

tahara amrita-vani — his nectarean speech; sinchila antara — sprinkled the heart; nachibare yaya prabhu — the Lord goes to dance; dhari tara kara — holding his hand

187His nectarean speech sprinkled [the Lord's] heart:
the Lord, taking him by the hand, goes to dance.

নরহরি-ভুজে আর ভুজ আরোপিয়া ।
শ্রীবাসের ঘরে নাচে রাস-বিনোদিয়া ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

narahari-bhuje āra bhuja āropiẏā |
śrībāsera ghare nāce rāsa-binodiẏā || 188 ||

narahari-bhuje — on Narahari's arm; ara bhuja aropiya — placing His other arm; shrivasera ghare — in Srivasa's house; nache — dances; rasa-vinodiya — the Charmer of the rasa

188Placing His other arm on Narahari's arm,
the Charmer of the rasa dances in Srivasa's house.

গৌরদেহে শ্যাম তনু দেখে ভক্তগণ ।
গদাধর রাধারূপ হইলা তখন ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

gauradehe śyāma tanu dekhe bhaktagaṇa |
gadādhara rādhārūpa hailā takhana || 189 ||

gaura-dehe — in Gaura's body; shyama tanu — a dark form; dekhe bhakta-gana — the devotees see; gadadhara — Gadadhara; radha-rupa haila takhana — then took the form of Radha

189In Gaura's body the devotees see a dark form,
and Gadadhara then took the form of Radha.

মধুমতী নরহরি হৈলা সেইকালে ।
দেখিয়া বৈষ্ণব সব হরিহরি বোলে ॥ ১৯০ ॥

madhumatī narahari hailā seikāle |
dekhiẏā baiṣṇaba saba harihari bole || 190 ||

madhumati — Madhumati; narahari haila — Narahari became; sei-kale — at that moment; dekhiya — seeing; vaishnava saba — all the Vaishnavas; hari-hari bole — cry "Hari, Hari!"

190Narahari at that moment became Madhumati;
seeing this, all the Vaishnavas cry "Hari, Hari!"

বৃন্দাবন প্রকাশ হইল সেইস্থানে ।
গো-গোপী-গোপাল-সঙ্গে শচীর নন্দনে ॥ ১৯১ ॥

bṛndābana prakāśa haila seisthāne |
go-gopī-gopāla-saṅge śacīra nandane || 191 ||

vrindavana prakasha haila — Vrindavana appeared; sei-sthane — in that place; go-gopi-gopala-sange — with the cows, gopis and cowherd boys; shachira nandane — the son of Shachi

191In that place Vrindavana appeared:
the son of Shachi — with the cows, the gopis and the cowherd boys.

পূর্বে সখা সখীগণ যেরূপে আছিলা ।
রস-আস্বাদনে প্রভু-সঙ্গে ভক্ত হৈলা ॥ ১৯২ ॥

pūrbe sakhā sakhīgaṇa yerūpe āchilā |
rasa-āsbādane prabhu-saṅge bhakta hailā || 192 ||

purve — formerly; sakha sakhi-gana — the friends and girl-friends; ye-rupe achhila — as they were; rasa-asvadane — in tasting rasa; prabhu-sange — with the Lord; bhakta haila — the devotees became

192As the friends and girl-friends had been before,
so the devotees became beside the Lord, tasting rasa.

অভিনব-কামদেব শ্রীরঘুনন্দন ।
অপ্রাকৃত মদন বলিয়া যে গণন ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

abhinaba-kāmadeba śrīraghunandana |
aprākṛta madana baliẏā ye gaṇana || 193 ||

abhinava-kamadeva — a new Kamadeva; shri-raghunandana — Sri Raghunandana; aprakrita madana — the transcendental Madana; baliya ye ganana — so he is reckoned

193Sri Raghunandana is a new Kamadeva:
he is called the transcendental Madana.

তারা সব পূর্বদেহ ধরি' প্রভু-কাছে ।
আবরণ-ক্রমে তারা প্রভু বেড়ি' নাচে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

tārā saba pūrbadeha dhari' prabhu-kāche |
ābaraṇa-krame tārā prabhu beṛi' nāce || 194 ||

tara saba — all of them; purva-deha dhari — taking their former bodies; prabhu-kachhe — beside the Lord; avarana-krame — in the order of the enclosures; tara prabhu bedi nache — they dance around the Lord

194All of them, taking their former bodies, beside the Lord
dance round the Lord, circle within circle.

দেখি' অন্য-অবতার-সঙ্গী সব কান্দে ।
নবদ্বীপে উদয় করিল ব্রজচান্দে ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

dekhi' anya-abatāra-saṅgī saba kānde |
nabadbīpe udaẏa karila brajacānde || 195 ||

dekhi — seeing; anya-avatara-sangi — the associates of other avataras; saba kande — all weep; navadvipe — in Navadvipa; udaya karila — has risen; vraja-chande — the Moon of Vraja

195Seeing this, all the associates of other avataras weep:
in Navadvipa the Moon of Vraja has risen!

ক্ষণে গৌরলীলা গদাধর করি' সঙ্গে ।
ক্ষণে শ্যামলীলা রাধা-রাসরস-রঙ্গে ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

kṣaṇe gauralīlā gadādhara kari' saṅge |
kṣaṇe śyāmalīlā rādhā-rāsarasa-raṅge || 196 ||

kshane — now; gaura-lila — Gaura's lila; gadadhara kari sange — with Gadadhara; kshane — now; shyama-lila — Shyama's lila; radha-rasa-rasa-range — in the joy of the rasa of the rasa dance with Radha

196Now it is Gaura's lila with Gadadhara,
now Shyama's lila, the joy of the rasa of the rasa dance with Radha8.

চমৎকার লীলা দেখি' সব ভক্তগণ ।
হরিহরি জয় জয় বোলে ঘনে ঘন ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

camatkāra līlā dekhi' saba bhaktagaṇa |
harihari jaẏa jaẏa bole ghane ghana || 197 ||

chamatkara lila dekhi — seeing the wondrous lila; saba bhakta-gana — all the devotees; hari-hari jaya jaya — "Hari, Hari! Jaya, jaya!"; bole ghane ghana — cry again and again

197Seeing the wondrous lila, all the devotees
cry again and again: "Hari, Hari! Jaya, jaya!"

দিন-অবসানে সন্ধ্যা রম্য দিগন্তর ।
আচম্বিতে মেঘারম্ভ গগন-মণ্ডল ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

dina-abasāne sandhyā ramya digantara |
ācambite meghārambha gagana-maṇḍala || 198 ||

dina-avasane — at the end of the day; sandhya — evening; ramya digantara — lovely quarters; achambite — suddenly; megharambha — clouds gathered; gagana-mandala — the vault of the sky

198The day ended; it was evening, the quarters were lovely —
and suddenly clouds covered the vault of the sky.

ঘন ঘন গরজয়ে গম্ভীর-নিনাদে ।
দেখিয়া বৈষ্ণবগণ গণিল প্রমাদে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

ghana ghana garajaẏe gambhīra-nināde |
dekhiẏā baiṣṇabagaṇa gaṇila pramāde || 199 ||

ghana ghana — again and again; garajaye — it thunders; gambhira-ninade — with a deep roar; dekhiya — seeing; vaishnava-gana — the Vaishnavas; ganila pramade — took it for a calamity

199Again and again the thunder rolls;
seeing this, the Vaishnavas took it for a calamity.

বিঘ্ন উপসন্ন দেখি' সভেই দুঃখিত ।
কেমনে ঘুচয়ে বিঘ্ন চিন্তাপর-চিত ॥ ২০০ ॥

bighna upasanna dekhi' sabhei duḥkhita |
kemane ghucaẏe bighna cintāpara-cita || 200 ||

vighna upasanna dekhi — seeing a hindrance arrived; sabhei duhkhita — all are dejected; kemane ghuchaye vighna — how can the hindrance be removed; chintapara-chita — with anxious hearts

200Seeing that a hindrance had come, all were dejected;
anxiously they think: "How can the hindrance be removed?"

মেঘগণ প্রেম-পরসাদ নিতে আইলা ।
গৌরলীলা দেখি' প্রেমে গর্জিতে লাগিলা ॥ ২০১ ॥

meghagaṇa prema-parasāda nite āilā |
gauralīlā dekhi' preme garjite lāgilā || 201 ||

megha-gana — the clouds; prema-parasada nite aila — came to receive the grace of prema; gaura-lila dekhi — seeing Gaura's lila; preme garjite lagila — began to thunder with love

201[But] the clouds had come to receive the grace of prema:
seeing Gaura's lila, they thundered with love.

তবে মহাপ্রভু সে মন্দিরা করি' করে ।
নাম-গুণ-সংকীর্তন করে উচ্চস্বরে ॥ ২০২ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu se mandirā kari' kare |
nāma-guṇa-saṃkīrtana kare uccasbare || 202 ||

tabe mahaprabhu se — then Mahaprabhu; mandira kari kare — taking the mandiras in His hands; nama-guna-sankirtana — the sankirtana of names and qualities; kare uchcha-svare — performs aloud

202Then Mahaprabhu took the mandira cymbals in His hands
and loudly sings the sankirtana of names and qualities.

দেবলোক কৃতার্থ করিব হেন মনে ।
ঊর্ধ্বমুখে চাহে প্রভু আকাশের পানে ॥ ২০৩ ॥

debaloka kṛtārtha kariba hena mane |
ūrdhbamukhe cāhe prabhu ākāśera pāne || 203 ||

deva-loka — the heavenly world; kritartha kariba — I shall fulfil; hena mane — so thinking; urdhva-mukhe — with upturned face; chahe prabhu — the Lord gazes; akashera pane — at the sky

203Wishing to fulfil [the desires of] the heavenly world,
the Lord raised His face and gazes at the sky.

দূরে গেল মেঘগণ প্রকাশ আকাশ ।
হরিষে বৈষ্ণবগণের বাড়িল উল্লাস ॥ ২০৪ ॥

dūre gela meghagaṇa prakāśa ākāśa |
hariṣe baiṣṇabagaṇera bāṛila ullāsa || 204 ||

dure gela megha-gana — the clouds went far away; prakasha akasha — the sky cleared; harishe — in joy; vaishnava-ganera — of the Vaishnavas; badila ullasa — the jubilation increased

204The clouds went far away, the sky cleared,
and the jubilation of the Vaishnavas increased.

নিরমল ভেল শশি-রঞ্জিত রজনী ।
অনুগত গুণ গায় নাচয়ে আপনি ॥ ২০৫ ॥

niramala bhela śaśi-rañjita rajanī |
anugata guṇa gāẏa nācaẏe āpani || 205 ||

niramala bhela — became clear; shashi-ranjita rajani — the night tinged by the moon; anugata — the followers; guna gaya — sing the qualities; nachaye apani — He Himself dances

205The night became clear, tinged by the moon;
the devotees sing His qualities, and He Himself dances.

মেঘগণ নিজরূপ ধরি' প্রভু-কাছে ।
নাচিয়া বুলয়ে তারা ভক্ত-পাছে পাছে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

meghagaṇa nijarūpa dhari' prabhu-kāche |
nāciẏā bulaẏe tārā bhakta-pāche pāche || 206 ||

megha-gana — the clouds; nija-rupa dhari — taking their own form; prabhu-kachhe — beside the Lord; nachiya bulaye tara — they go about dancing; bhakta-pachhe pachhe — behind the devotees

206The clouds, taking their own form, beside the Lord
dance, following the devotees.

সেই প্রেম বিচার না করে গৌরহরি ।
মেঘে কি বলিব দিল ত্রিজগৎ ভরি' ॥ ২০৭ ॥

sei prema bicāra nā kare gaurahari |
meghe ki baliba dila trijagat bhari' || 207 ||

sei prema — [in giving] this prema; vichara na kare — makes no distinction; gaurahari — Gaurahari; meghe ki baliba — what to speak of the clouds; dila trijagat bhari — He gave it, filling the three worlds

207In giving this prema Gaurahari makes no distinction:
what to speak of clouds — He filled the three worlds with it!

আপনে ঠাকুর নাচে ভক্তগণ-সনে ।
সভার আবেশে নাচে শচীর নন্দনে ॥ ২০৮ ॥

āpane ṭhākura nāce bhaktagaṇa-sane |
sabhāra ābeśe nāce śacīra nandane || 208 ||

apane thakura — the Thakura Himself; nache bhakta-gana-sane — dances with the devotees; sabhara aveshe — in the ecstasy of all; nache shachira nandane — the son of Shachi dances

208The Thakura Himself dances with the devotees:
amid the ecstasy of all dances the son of Shachi.

প্রেমার আবেশে নাচে মহানটরাজে ।
পদাম্বুজে মুখর মঞ্জীর ঘন বাজে ॥ ২০৯ ॥

premāra ābeśe nāce mahānaṭarāje |
padāmbuje mukhara mañjīra ghana bāje || 209 ||

premara aveshe — in the ecstasy of prema; nache maha-nataraje — the great King of dancers dances; padambuje — on the lotus feet; mukhara manjira — the ringing anklets; ghana baje — sound loudly

209In the ecstasy of prema the great King of dancers dances;
on His lotus feet the anklets ring loudly.

বিপ্রসাধ্বীগণ জয় জয় দেই সুখে ।
আকাশেতে দেবগণ দেখয়ে কৌতুকে ॥ ২১০ ॥

biprasādhbīgaṇa jaẏa jaẏa dei sukhe |
ākāśete debagaṇa dekhaẏe kautuke || 210 ||

vipra-sadhvi-gana — the virtuous wives of the brahmanas; jaya jaya dei sukhe — joyfully cry "Jaya, jaya!"; akashete deva-gana — the gods in the sky; dekhaye kautuke — watch the festival

210The virtuous wives of the brahmanas joyfully cry "Jaya, jaya!";
from the sky the gods watch the festival9.

প্রেমায়ে বিভোল সব নাচে ভক্তগণ ।
না জানি কি কৈল তপঃ কতেক জনম ॥ ২১১ ॥

premāẏe bibhola saba nāce bhaktagaṇa |
nā jāni ki kaila tapaḥ kateka janama || 211 ||

premaye vibhola — intoxicated with prema; saba nache bhakta-gana — all the devotees dance; na jani — who knows; ki kaila tapah — what austerities they did; kateka janama — for how many births

211All the devotees dance, intoxicated with prema:
who knows what austerities they performed — for how many births —

তাহার কারণে নাচে ঠাকুরের সনে ।
আমোদ করয়ে তারা প্রেম হেন ধনে ॥ ২১২ ॥

tāhāra kāraṇe nāce ṭhākurera sane |
āmoda karaẏe tārā prema hena dhane || 212 ||

tahara karane — for that reason; nache thakurera sane — they dance with the Thakura; amoda karaye tara — they make merry; prema hena dhane — with such a treasure as prema

212that for them they dance with the Thakura
and make merry with such a treasure as prema?

করুণায় ছাইল প্রভু এ ভূমি আকাশ ।
শুনি' আনন্দিত কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২১৩ ॥

karuṇāẏa chāila prabhu e bhūmi ākāśa |
śuni' ānandita kahe e locanadāsa || 213 ||

karunaya chhaila prabhu — with compassion the Lord covered; e bhumi akasha — this earth and sky; shuni — hearing; anandita kahe — joyfully says; e lochanadasa — Lochana Dasa

213With His compassion the Lord covered both earth and sky.
Hearing of it, Lochana Dasa speaks in joy.

Mercy to Mukunda

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. The author, having described the wondrous beauty and loveliness of Sriman Mahaprabhu, glorifies the lila of planting the mango tree. One day Sriman Mahaprabhu, before the devotees, planted a mango stone; before their eyes it at once sprouted, gradually became a tree and blossomed; mangoes appeared on the tree and at once ripened; the devotees offered them to Bhagavan and all together honoured the prasada. Afterwards they saw that none of it was there any more — everything had vanished. Then Sriman Mahaprabhu, by the example of that tree, showed the illusoriness of samsara and taught how to conquer maya; He instructed Mukunda Datta in the worship of Sri Krishna, whose form is full of sweetness, and bade him give up speculation about the Self (adhyatma) and serve Bhagavan. When Murari Gupta asked Sriman Mahaprabhu for the mercy of bhakti, the Lord blessed him. Srivasa and Sri Rama Pandita are very dear to Sriman Mahaprabhu; in their house Sriman Mahaprabhu enjoyed the bliss of kirtana with the devotees. One day, when a certain foolish brahmana called Sri Krishna a product of maya, Sriman Mahaprabhu, hearing it, bathed in the Ganga with His clothes on10.

Raga shyamagada. [Opening:]
*Like the peak of Sumeru is His beautiful tall body;
under the weight of prema He sways.
His whole body thrills from feet to crown,
His red eyes brim with tears.*

Refrain: "The town of Nadia rejoices: splendidly dances Shachi's son!"

শ্রীনিবাস চারি ভাই, আনন্দে মঙ্গল গাই,
হরিদাস হরিহরি বোলে ।
কিশোরী-কিশোর যেন, গোরাগুণ-গরজন,
হুহুঙ্কার প্রেমার হিল্লোলে ॥ ১ ॥

śrīnibāsa cāri bhāi, ānande maṅgala gāi,
haridāsa harihari bole |
kiśorī-kiśora yena, gorāguṇa-garajana,
huhuṅkāra premāra hillole || 1 ||

shrinibasa chari bhai — Srinivasa, the four brothers; anande mangala gai — joyfully sing auspicious songs; haridasa hari-hari bole — Haridasa cries "Hari, Hari!"; kishori-kishora yena — like Kishori and Kishora; gora-guna-garajana — the roaring of Gora's qualities; huhunkara — cries of "hum!"; premara hillole — in the surge of prema

1The four brothers — Srinivasa and his brothers — joyfully sing auspicious songs,
Haridasa cries "Hari, Hari!"
[Gora is] like Kishori and Kishora; [all] loudly proclaim Gora's glories,
roaring "hum!" in the surge of prema.

মুরারি মুকুন্দদত্ত, গুণ গায় অবিরত,
উলসিত পুলকিত গায় ।
প্রেম-মকরন্দ-আশে, পদ-অরবিন্দ-পাশে,
যেন মত্ত ভ্রমর বেড়ায় ॥ ২ ॥

murāri mukundadatta, guṇa gāẏa abirata,
ulasita pulakita gāẏa |
prema-makaranda-āśe, pada-arabinda-pāśe,
yena matta bhramara beṛāẏa || 2 ||

murari mukunda-datta — Murari and Mukunda Datta; guna gaya avirata — sing the qualities without pause; ullasita pulakita gaya — exultant, with thrilling bodies; prema-makaranda-ashe — in hope of the nectar of prema; pada-aravinda-pashe — near the lotus feet; yena matta bhramara bedaya — hover like intoxicated bees

2Murari and Mukunda Datta sing His qualities without pause,
exultant, thrilling.
In hope of the nectar of prema, near His lotus feet
they hover like intoxicated bees.

চৌদিগে জয় বোল, মাঝে নাচে হেমগৌর,
আনন্দে বিভোর জনা-জনা ।
যে-দিগে সে-দিগে চাহি, আনন্দিত সব-ঠাঞি,
দশদিগে প্রেমের কান্দনা ॥ ৩ ॥

caudige jaẏa bola, mājhe nāce hemagaura,
ānande bibhora janā-janā |
ye-dige se-dige cāhi, ānandita saba-ṭhāñi,
daśadige premera kāndanā || 3 ||

chaudige jaya bola — all around cries of "Jaya!"; majhe nache hema-gaura — in the middle golden Gaura dances; anande vibhora jana-jana — each person beside himself with bliss; ye-dige se-dige chahi — wherever one looks; anandita saba-thani — joy everywhere; dasha-dige premera kandana — in the ten directions the weeping of prema

3All around they cry "Jaya!", and in the middle dances golden Gaura;
everyone is beside himself with bliss.
Wherever one looks, there is joy everywhere,
in all ten directions — the weeping of prema.

কেহো কেহো দুহে মেলি, প্রেমানন্দে কোলাকুলি,
কেহো যশোগানে হয় ভাট ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, পণ্ডিত গোসাঞি বোলে,
পসারিলা অপরূপ হাট ॥ ৪ ॥

keho keho duhe meli, premānande kolākuli,
keho yaśogāne haẏa bhāṭa |
paṛiẏā caraṇatale, paṇḍita gosāñi bole,
pasārilā aparūpa hāṭa || 4 ||

keho keho duhe meli — some, meeting in twos; premanande kolakuli — embrace in the bliss of prema; keho yasho-gane haya bhata — some become bards singing His fame; padiya charana-tale — falling at His feet; pandita gosani bole — Pandita Gosani says; pasarila aparupa hata — You have spread out a wondrous market

4Some, meeting in twos, embrace in the bliss of prema,
some sing His fame like bards.
Falling at His feet, Pandita Gosani says:
"You have spread out a wondrous market!"11

সোণার মুকুতা জনু, পুলকে গাঁথিল তনু,
অনুরাগে অরুণ বদন ।
রসের আলসে হাসে, অলস-লস আবেশে,
প্রকাশয়ে অন্তরের ধন ॥ ৫ ॥

soṇāra mukutā janu, pulake gāṁthila tanu,
anurāge aruṇa badana |
rasera ālase hāse, alasa-lasa ābeśe,
prakāśaẏe antarera dhana || 5 ||

sonara mukuta janu — like golden pearls; pulake ganthila tanu — the thrill strung on the body; anurage aruna badana — the face red with love; rasera alase hase — He laughs in the languor of rasa; alasa-lasa aveshe — languid in rapture; prakashaye antarera dhana — reveals the treasure of the heart

5As if golden pearls were strung — so the thrill [covers] His body,
His face is red with love.
In the languor of rasa He laughs, languid in rapture,
and reveals the treasure of His heart.

ক্ষণে অলৌকিক বোলে, যেন মদ-মাতোয়ালে,
ক্ষণে বোলে মুঞি ভগবান্ ।
ক্ষণে পরণাম করে, ক্ষণে আশীর্বাদ বোলে,
ক্ষণে নিজজনে দেই বর দান ॥ ৬ ॥

kṣaṇe alaukika bole, yena mada-mātoẏāle,
kṣaṇe bole muñi bhagabān |
kṣaṇe paraṇāma kare, kṣaṇe āśīrbāda bole,
kṣaṇe nijajane dei bara dāna || 6 ||

kshane alaukika bole — now He speaks unearthly things; yena mada-matoyale — as if intoxicated; kshane bole — now He says; muni bhagavan — "I am Bhagavan"; kshane paranama kare — now He bows; kshane ashirvada bole — now He blesses; kshane nija-jane dei bara dana — now He gives boons to His own

6Now He speaks unearthly things, as if intoxicated,
now He says: "I am Bhagavan!"
Now He bows down, now He pronounces blessings,
now He grants boons to His own.

প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে প্রভু, যা নাহি দেখয়ে কভু,
সপ্তদ্বীপে লাগিল তরাস ।
কি নারী পুরুষ সব, দেখি' গোরা-অনুভব,
প্রেমে ভুলি' গেল এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৭ ॥

prema prakāśaẏe prabhu, yā nāhi dekhaẏe kabhu,
saptadbīpe lāgila tarāsa |
ki nārī puruṣa saba, dekhi' gorā-anubhaba,
preme bhuli' gela e locanadāsa || 7 ||

prema prakashaye prabhu — the Lord reveals prema; ya nahi dekhaye kabhu — such as was never seen; sapta-dvipe lagila tarasa — a trembling seized the seven continents; ki nari purusha saba — all, women and men; dekhi gora-anubhava — seeing Gora's experience; preme bhuli gela — forgot himself in prema; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

7The Lord reveals a prema never seen before:
a trembling seized the seven continents.
All — women and men — seeing what Gora experienced, [forgot themselves],
and in prema this Lochana Dasa forgot himself.

Raga dhanashi, tune taraja; refrain: "What creator is this — he made beautiful Gauranga and kept his own body? How hard he is, with a heart of wood and stone: seeing this beauty, he did not melt away!"12

অমিয় মথিয়া কেবা, নবনী তুলিল গো,
তাহাতে গঢ়িল গোরা-দেহা ।
জগৎ ছানিঞা কেবা, রস নিঙাড়িল গো,
এক কৈল সুধুই সুনেহা ॥ ৮ ॥

amiẏa mathiẏā kebā, nabanī tulila go,
tāhāte gaṛhila gorā-dehā |
jagat chāniñā kebā, rasa niṅāṛila go,
eka kaila sudhui sunehā || 8 ||

amiya mathiya keba — who, churning nectar; navani tulila go — took off the butter; tahate gadhila gora-deha — fashioned Gora's body from it; jagat chhanina keba — who, sifting the world; rasa ningadila go — squeezed out the rasa; eka kaila sudhui suneha — blended it into pure tenderness

8Who, churning nectar, took off its butter
and from it fashioned Gora's body?
Who sifted the whole world, squeezed out its rasa
and blended it into one — pure tenderness?

অনুরাগের দধিখানি, প্রেমার সাঁচন দিয়া,
কেবা পাতিয়াছে আঁখি দুটি ।
তাহাতে অধিক মহু, লহু লহু কথা গো,
হাসিয়া বোলয়ে গুটি গুটি ॥ ৯ ॥

anurāgera dadhikhāni, premāra sāṁcana diẏā,
kebā pātiẏāche āṁkhi duṭi |
tāhāte adhika mahu, lahu lahu kathā go,
hāsiẏā bolaẏe guṭi guṭi || 9 ||

anuragera dadhikhani — the curd of anuraga; premara sanchana diya — with a culture of prema; keba patiyachhe — who has set (made); ankhi duti — the two eyes; tahate adhika mahu — sweeter than honey; lahu lahu katha go — soft words; hasiya bolaye guti guti — smiling, He speaks them one by one

9Who set the curd of anuraga with a culture of prema
and made [of it] His two eyes?
Sweeter still are His soft words:
smiling, He lets them fall one by one.

অখণ্ড-পীযূষধারা, কে না আউটিল গো,
সোণার বরণ হৈল চিনি ।
সে চিনি মারিয়া কেবা, ফেণি তুলিল গো,
হেন বাসোঁ গোরা-অঙ্গখানি ॥ ১০ ॥

akhaṇḍa-pīyūṣadhārā, ke nā āuṭila go,
soṇāra baraṇa haila cini |
se cini māriẏā kebā, pheṇi tulila go,
hena bāsoṁ gorā-aṅgakhāni || 10 ||

akhanda-piyusha-dhara — the unbroken stream of nectar; ke na autila go — who boiled down; sonara varana haila chini — became gold-coloured sugar; se chini mariya keba — who, beating that sugar; pheni tulila go — raised the froth; hena baso — so it seems to me; gora-angakhani — Gora's body

10Who boiled down an unbroken stream of nectar
till it became sugar the colour of gold?
Who, beating that sugar, raised the froth? —
so Gora's body seems to me.

বিজুরী বাটিয়া কেবা, গা-খানি মাজিল গো,
চান্দে মাজিল মুখখানি ।
লাবণ্য বাটিয়া কে বা, চিত্র-নিরমাণ কৈল,
অপরূপ রূপের বলনি ॥ ১১ ॥

bijurī bāṭiẏā kebā, gā-khāni mājila go,
cānde mājila mukhakhāni |
lābaṇya bāṭiẏā ke bā, citra-niramāṇa kaila,
aparūpa rūpera balani || 11 ||

bijuri batiya keba — who, grinding lightning; gakhani majila go — rubbed the body; chande majila mukhakhani — rubbed the face with the moon; lavanya batiya ke ba — who, grinding loveliness; chitra-niramana kaila — painted the picture; aparupa rupera balani — the wondrous fashioning of the form

11Who, grinding lightning, rubbed His body with it,
rubbed His face with the moon?
Who, grinding loveliness, painted this picture —
the wondrous fashioning of [His] form?

সকল পূর্ণিমার চান্দে, বিকল হইয়া কান্দে,
কর-পদ-পদুমের গন্ধে ।
কুড়িটা নখের ছটা, জগৎ আলা কৈল গো,
আঁখি পাইল জনমের আন্ধে ॥ ১২ ॥

sakala pūrṇimāra cānde, bikala haiẏā kānde,
kara-pada-padumera gandhe |
kuṛiṭā nakhera chaṭā, jagat ālā kaila go,
āṁkhi pāila janamera āndhe || 12 ||

sakala purnimara chande — all the full moons; bikala haiya kande — weep distraught; kara-pada-padumera gandhe — at the fragrance of the lotuses of the hands and feet; kudita nakhera chhata — the radiance of the twenty nails; jagat ala kaila go — lit up the world; ankhi paila janamera andhe — the born-blind received eyes

12All the full moons weep, distraught,
at the fragrance of the lotuses of His hands and feet.
The radiance of His twenty nails lit up the world:
those blind from birth received sight.

এমন বিনোদিয়া গোরা, কোথাও দেখিয়ে নাই,
অপরূপ প্রেমার বিনোদে ।
পুরুষ প্রকৃতি-ভাবে, কান্দিয়া বিকল গো,
নারী কেমনে প্রাণ বান্ধে ॥ ১৩ ॥

emana binodiẏā gorā, kothāo dekhiẏe nāi,
aparūpa premāra binode |
puruṣa prakṛti-bhābe, kāndiẏā bikala go,
nārī kemane prāṇa bāndhe || 13 ||

emana vinodiya gora — such a charming Gora; kothao dekhiye nai — is seen nowhere; aparupa premara vinode — in the wondrous play of prema; purusha prakriti-bhave — men in the mood of women; kandiya bikala go — weep distraught; nari kemane prana bandhe — how can a woman keep her life

13Such a charming Gora is seen nowhere —
in the wondrous play of prema.
Men, in the mood of women, weep, distraught —
how can a woman keep life [in her body]?

সকল রসের রসে, বিলাস হৃদয়খানি,
কে না গঢ়াইল রঙ্গ দিয়া ।
মদন বাটিয়া কে বা, বদন গঢ়িল গো,
বিনি ভাবে মো মলুঁ কান্দিয়া ॥ ১৪ ॥

sakala rasera rase, bilāsa hṛdaẏakhāni,
ke nā gaṛhāila raṅga diẏā |
madana bāṭiẏā ke bā, badana gaṛhila go,
bini bhābe mo maluṁ kāndiẏā || 14 ||

sakala rasera rase — from the rasa of all rasas; vilasa hridayakhani — the heart, an abode of play; ke na gadhaila ranga diya — who fashioned with delight; madana batiya ke ba — who, grinding Madana; badana gadhila go — fashioned the face; vini bhave — pining without [Him]; mo malun kandiya — I die weeping

14Who made His heart — an abode of play — from the rasa of all rasas,
shaping it with delight?
Who, grinding Madana, fashioned His face?
And I, without Him, must die in tears.

ইন্দ্রের ধনুক আনি', গোরার কপালে গো,
কে না দিল চন্দনের রেখা ।
ও-রূপ স্বরূপে যত, কুলের কামিনী গো,
দুই হাথ করিতে চাহে পাখা ॥ ১৫ ॥

indrera dhanuka āni', gorāra kapāle go,
ke nā dila candanera rekhā |
o-rūpa sbarūpe yata, kulera kāminī go,
dui hātha karite cāhe pākhā || 15 ||

indrera dhanuka ani — bringing Indra's bow; gorara kapale go — on Gora's forehead; ke na dila chandanera rekha — who drew the line of sandal; o-rupa svarupe — [seeing] that form truly; yata kulera kamini go — all the women of noble families; dui hatha karite chahe pakha — long to make their two arms wings

15Who brought Indra's bow
and drew with it the line of sandal on Gora's forehead?
At the sight of this form all the women of noble families
long to turn their arms into wings.

রঙ্গের মন্দিরখানি, নানারত্ন দিয়া গো,
গঢ়াইল বড় অনুবন্ধে ।
লীলা-বিনোদ-কলা, ভাবের বিলাস গো,
মদন-বেদনা ভাবি' কান্দে ॥ ১৬ ॥

raṅgera mandirakhāni, nānāratna diẏā go,
gaṛhāila baṛa anubandhe |
līlā-binoda-kalā, bhābera bilāsa go,
madana-bedanā bhābi' kānde || 16 ||

rangera mandirakhani — the temple of delight; nana-ratna diya go — of many jewels; gadhaila bada anubandhe — was carved with great care; lila-vinoda-kala — the art of playful lilas; bhavera vilasa go — the play of bhavas; madana-bedana bhavi kande — thinking of Madana's pain, she weeps

16[His body,] a temple of delight, was carved
with great care from many jewels.
The art of playful lilas, the play of bhavas...
thinking of Madana's pain, [a woman] weeps.

না চাহে আঁখির কোণে, সদাই সভার মনে,
দেখিবারে আঁখি-পাখী ধায় ।
আঁখির পিয়াস দেখি', মুখে লালস গো,
অলসল জরজর গায় ॥ ১৭ ॥

nā cāhe āṁkhira koṇe, sadāi sabhāra mane,
dekhibāre āṁkhi-pākhī dhāẏa |
āṁkhira piẏāsa dekhi', mukhe lālasa go,
alasala jarajara gāẏa || 17 ||

na chahe ankhira kone — He does not glance from the corners of the eyes; sadai sabhara mane — always in everyone's heart; dekhibare ankhi-pakhi dhaya — the eye-birds fly to see; ankhira piyasa dekhi — seeing the eyes' thirst; mukhe lalasa go — longing in the mouth; alasala jarajara gaya — the body languid and exhausted

17He does not glance from the corners of His eyes, yet always in everyone's heart
the eye-birds fly to see Him.
Seeing the eyes' thirst, the lips too are filled with longing;
the body is languid and exhausted.

কুলবতী কুল ছাড়ে, পঙ্গু ধায় উভ-রড়ে,
গুণ গায় অসুর-পাষণ্ড ।
ধুলায় লোটাঞা কান্দে, কেহো স্থির নাহি বান্ধে,
গোরাগুণ অমিয় অখণ্ড ॥ ১৮ ॥

kulabatī kula chāṛe, paṅgu dhāẏa ubha-raṛe,
guṇa gāẏa asura-pāṣaṇḍa |
dhulāẏa loṭāñā kānde, keho sthira nāhi bāndhe,
gorāguṇa amiẏa akhaṇḍa || 18 ||

kulavati kula chhade — chaste wives leave their families; pangu dhaya ubha-rade — the lame run headlong; guna gaya asura-pashanda — asuras and atheists sing the qualities; dhulaya lotana kande — rolling in the dust they weep; keho sthira nahi bandhe — no one stays composed; gora-guna amiya akhanda — Gora's qualities are unending nectar

18Chaste wives leave their families, the lame run headlong,
asuras and atheists sing His qualities,
roll in the dust and weep; no one can stay composed:
Gora's qualities are unending nectar.

ধাওরে ধাওরে বলি', প্রেমানন্দে কোলাকুলি,
কেহো নাচে কেহো অট্ট হাসে ।
সুশীলা কুলের বধূ, সে বোলে সকল যাউ,
গোরা-গুণ-রূপের বাতাসে ॥ ১৯ ॥

dhāore dhāore bali', premānande kolākuli,
keho nāce keho aṭṭa hāse |
suśīlā kulera badhū, se bole sakala yāu,
gorā-guṇa-rūpera bātāse || 19 ||

dhaore dhaore bali — crying "run, run!"; premanande kolakuli — embracing in the bliss of prema; keho nache — some dance; keho atta hase — some laugh aloud; sushila kulera badhu — the modest wife of a noble house; se bole sakala yau — she says, "let everything go"; gora-guna-rupera batase — in the breeze of Gora's qualities and beauty

19"Run, run!" they cry, and embrace in the bliss of prema;
some dance, some laugh aloud.
Even the modest wife of a noble house says: "Let everything go!" —
in the breeze of Gora's qualities and beauty.

নদিয়ানগর-বধূ, হেরি' গোরা-মুখবিধু,
ঝরঝর নয়নে সদাই ।
অনুরাগে বুক ভরে, পুলকিত কলেবরে,
মনমাঝে সদাই জাগাই ॥ ২০ ॥

nadiẏānagara-badhū, heri' gorā-mukhabidhu,
jharajhara naẏane sadāi |
anurāge buka bhare, pulakita kalebare,
manamājhe sadāi jāgāi || 20 ||

nadiya-nagara-badhu — the wives of the town of Nadia; heri gora-mukha-vidhu — beholding the moon of Gora's face; jharajhara nayane sadai — ever shed streams of tears; anurage buka bhare — breasts filled with love; pulakita kalebare — bodies thrilling; manamajhe sadai jagai — in the heart [He] is ever awake

20The wives of the town of Nadia, beholding the moon of Gora's face,
ever shed streams of tears.
Their breasts fill with love, their bodies thrill,
in their hearts [He] is ever awake.

যোগীন্দ্র মুনীন্দ্র কিবা, মনে গণে রাত্রি দিবা,
গোরাগুণে লাগি' গেল ধান্ধা ।
অখিল-ভুবনপতি, ধুলায় লোটাঞা কান্দে,
সদাই সোঙরে রাধা-রাধা ॥ ২১ ॥

yogīndra munīndra kibā, mane gaṇe rātri dibā,
gorāguṇe lāgi' gela dhāndhā |
akhila-bhubanapati, dhulāẏa loṭāñā kānde,
sadāi soṅare rādhā-rādhā || 21 ||

yogindra munindra kiba — even the best of yogis and sages; mane gane ratri diba — pondering day and night; gora-gune lagi gela dhandha — are bewildered by Gora's qualities; akhila-bhuvana-pati — the Lord of all worlds; dhulaya lotana kande — rolls in the dust and weeps; sadai sonare radha-radha — ever remembering "Radha, Radha!"

21Even the best of yogis and sages, pondering day and night,
are bewildered by Gora's qualities.
The Lord of all worlds rolls in the dust and weeps,
ever remembering: "Radha, Radha!"

লখিমী-বিলাস ছাড়ি', প্রেম-অভিলাষী গো,
অনুরাগে রাঙা দুটি আঁখি ।
রাধার ধেয়ানে হিয়া, বেকত না হয় গো,
ওই গোরা তনু তার সাখী ॥ ২২ ॥

lakhimī-bilāsa chāṛi', prema-abhilāṣī go,
anurāge rāṅā duṭi āṁkhi |
rādhāra dheẏāne hiẏā, bekata nā haẏa go,
oi gorā tanu tāra sākhī || 22 ||

lakhimi-vilasa chhadi — leaving the play with Lakshmi; prema-abhilashi go — longing for prema; anurage ranga duti ankhi — both eyes red with love; radhara dheyane hiya — the heart in meditation on Radha; bekata na haya go — is not revealed; oi gora tanu tara sakhi — that golden body is its witness

22Leaving His play with Lakshmi, He longs for prema;
both His eyes are red with love.
[His] heart, absorbed in meditation on Radha, is not revealed;
the witness to it is that golden body13.

দেখরে দেখরে লোক, হেন প্রেম অপরূপ,
ত্রিজগৎ-নাথ-নাথ হঞা ।
অকিঞ্চনজন-সঙ্গে, কি জানি কি ধন মাগে,
কিবা সুখে বুলয়ে নাচিয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

dekhare dekhare loka, hena prema aparūpa,
trijagat-nātha-nātha hañā |
akiñcanajana-saṅge, ki jāni ki dhana māge,
kibā sukhe bulaẏe nāciẏā || 23 ||

dekhare dekhare loka — look, look, people; hena prema aparupa — such wondrous prema; trijagat-natha-natha hana — being the Lord of the lords of the three worlds; akinchana-jana-sange — in the company of the destitute; ki jani ki dhana mage — who knows what wealth He begs; kiba sukhe bulaye nachiya — with what joy He goes dancing

23Look, look, people — what wondrous prema!
Though He is the Lord of the lords of the three worlds,
in the company of the destitute — who knows what wealth He begs? —
with what joy He goes about dancing!

জয় রে জয় রে জয়, হেন প্রেমরসালয়,
ভাঙ্গি' বিলাইল গোরারায় ।
নির্জীবে জীবন পাইল, পঙ্গু গিরি ডিঙ্গাইল,
আনন্দে লোচনদাসে গায় ॥ ২৪ ॥

jaẏa re jaẏa re jaẏa, hena premarasālaẏa,
bhāṅgi' bilāila gorārāẏa |
nirjībe jībana pāila, paṅgu giri ḍiṅgāila,
ānande locanadāse gāẏa || 24 ||

jaya re jaya re jaya — glory, glory, glory; hena prema-rasalaya — such a storehouse of the rasa of prema; bhangi bilaila gora-raya — Gora-raya broke open and gave away; nirjibe jibana paila — the lifeless received life; pangu giri dingaila — the lame leapt over mountains; anande lochanadase gaya — joyfully sings Lochana Dasa

24Glory, glory, glory! Such a storehouse of the rasa of prema
Gora-raya broke open and gave away.
The lifeless received life, the lame leapt over mountains —
joyfully sings Lochana Dasa.

✦

Notes

  1. The four-faced one is Brahma, the five-faced Shiva, the six-faced Skanda (Karttikeya). Cf. Murari 2.3.1–2.
  2. Cf. Murari 2.3.3–4: the Lord touches the devotees' bodies with His feet, and they beg devotion to His feet.
  3. Cf. Murari 2.3.5–8. The Lord does not belittle Mathura and Dvaraka: He says that mere bodily residence in holy places, without love for Krishna, does not yet bear fruit (cf. Bhagavata 10.84.13).
  4. "True feeling" (sad-bhava) is explained by Bhaktisiddhanta in his gloss on the verse as purity of mind. The source of the verse is not given in the edition.
  5. V. 174+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition; the 1903 edition lacks it too).
  6. Cf. Murari 2.3.10–17; there the Lord tells Gadadhara that in the morning he will distribute His prasada to the Vaishnavas.
  7. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, Gadadhara Pandita is Sri Radha Herself (Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika 147–153); Murari (2.3.17) compares this service to Radha preparing Krishna's bed.
  8. Vv. 188–196: Vrindavana and the rasa-lila appear in Srivasa's house; Gadadhara is Radha, Narahari Madhumati (see the Sutra-khanda, en/08, v. 645), Raghunandana "the transcendental (aprakrita) Madana", i.e. Kandarpa, not the mundane god of lust (in the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika — Pradyumna; cf. en/08, note 19). The rasa here is a spiritual lila, not mundane love. "Circle within circle" — lit. "in the order of the enclosures (avarana)": the associates surround the Lord in circles, as in meditation on His abode. Lochana Dasa, a disciple of Narahari, brings the Shrikhanda devotees into this scene; other biographies do not describe it.
  9. Vv. 198–213 — cf. Murari 2.3.18–27. The brahmanas' wives raise the auspicious cry "ulu-ulu".
  10. The summary covers the whole section; this portion contains only the song of Gaura's dance (vv. 1–24); the rest (the mango tree, the instructions to Mukunda and Murari, Srivasa and Sri Rama, the blaspheming brahmana) is in the next portion.
  11. Pandita Gosani is Gadadhara Pandita. The "market" is an image of the lavish distribution of prema.
  12. The voices of this song are the women of Nadia (vv. 13–20): here again is Lochana Dasa's "nagari-bhava" (see en/09, note 9). The "creator" who supposedly made Gaura is a poetic figure: the Lord's form is eternal and created by no one.
  13. That is, the Lord hides that His heart is absorbed in Radha, but His golden complexion — Radha's complexion — betrays it. So too in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology: Gaura is Krishna who has taken Radha's bhava and complexion (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4).
